why.title: More control over how you get paid
why.sub: Three reasons publishers are adding USDT to their payout options.
items: No more bank delays
Blockchain settlement is near-instant once you claim, unlike multi-day bank transfer windows.
Fiat or digital, your call
USD withdrawals now support both traditional transfer and USDT, an efficient, seamless payment experience built for cross-border publishers.
Your choice, anytime
Switch between Bank Transfer, PayPal, or USDT whenever it suits you, with no long-term commitment.

setup.title: How setup works
setup.sub: Five steps in Payment Settings. It takes about 2 minutes.
items: Open Payment Settings
Go to Settings > Payment > Payment Details, then select Edit.
Add your address and payout type
Enter your address, then set Payout Type to Stablecoins. Your payout currency is fixed to USD automatically.
Complete your account details
Enter your Name, Account Type, Nationality, Contact Number, and the Recipient Email Address where you’ll receive your payout claim link.
Send a test email (optional)
Confirm your recipient email is correct and active before your first real payout link is sent there.
Save
That’s it. Future eligible payouts will be ready to claim in USDT.

know.title: Good to know
know.sub: A few things worth knowing before you set up USDT withdrawal.
items: No wallet needed yet
You’ll enter your wallet address securely each time you claim a payout, not during setup.
1% processing fee
Deducted automatically from your gross payout and itemized on your Involve withdrawal invoice.
Backed by a regulated partner
Payouts are processed via Triple A, licensed by the Monetary Authority of Singapore.
One-time ID check
First payouts above USD 1,500 may require a quick identity check, per standard regulations.
Switch back anytime
You can change back to Bank Transfer or PayPal anytime in Payment Settings.

warn.title: Double-check before you continue
items: Make sure your email address is correct.
Your USDT payout claim link is sent only to the email you set during setup. An incorrect or outdated address can mean permanent, unrecoverable loss of your funds.
Double-check your wallet address and network every time you claim a payout.
Blockchain transactions can’t be reversed once submitted, not by you and not by us.
